theme_plan_amendment.scope: Additive work and acceptance checks for this phase; planning only, no execution authorization

entry_gate: Previous phase completion and explicit owner authorization; recorded boundary exception may permit execution without claiming user acceptance
exit_gate: Required steps/checkpoints complete; review packet and explicit user acceptance before ordinary next-phase execution

steps.title: build complete offline packs
steps.work: package selected readings, annotations, prepared activities, narration, visual assets and the pinned local embedding model/index with an exact readiness manifest. Download selected local models through explicit user-controlled preparation. Validate any optional local generative tutor separately if offline fresh tutoring is later approved.
steps.deliverables: inspectable offline packs and clear capability states.
steps.source_checks: disconnected cold-start; every claimed resource accessible; local semantic retrieval works; incomplete or model-mismatched indexes are not ready; optional fresh local generation tested separately from required embeddings and cached responses; no remote fetch dependency. Audit and checkpoint.

acceptance_criteria.description: fresh local inference tested separately from cached responses

steps.title: implement portable backup and safe restore
steps.work: export course data, files, source versions, attempts, annotations and media metadata with checksums; offer restore preview and safe conflict handling. Exclude credentials; define optional inclusion of large media/models.
steps.source_checks: clean-directory restore matches expected records and hashes; corruption rejected; interrupted restore preserves existing data; version mismatch handled; no path traversal. Audit and checkpoint.

steps.work: add a small synthetic second-course module through the documented interfaces; verify optional capability registration without editing unrelated modules. Document how future business/other courses extend templates and data.
steps.deliverables: extension guide and test module fixture.
steps.source_checks: module registration/version mismatch; disable/re-enable without data loss; no cross-course retrieval leakage; migrations preserve existing course; no arbitrary plugin execution. Audit and checkpoint.
